## About
RB Landscaping is a fully licensed landscaping company here in the Bay Area, based in Redwood City. We firmly believe that as landscapers, we're in the business of helping people, so we do our best to offer fair prices with exceptional service.
No project is too small or too big for us. We do everything from commercial space renovations to simple irrigation repairs. Customers tell us about Nate answering their questions and crews led by Hugo, Gustavo and Jesus doing the work.
We've always stood behind our work. You can hear from our clients themselves through our reviews or our Yelp page.

## Services
- Sprinkler/Irrigation System Installations & Repairs: New irrigation systems and repairs to the one you have, from a single broken line to a full install.
- Pavers: Paver driveways, walkways and patios laid with care for the details.
- Retaining Walls: Retaining walls built to hold your slope and look good doing it.
- Stair Construction: Custom outdoor stairs built to fit your property.
- Sod/Artificial Turf Installations: Fresh sod or artificial turf, installed and ready to enjoy.
- Concrete and Masonry: Concrete and masonry work for walkways, borders and hardscape.
- Driveway and Sidewalk Services: New driveways and sidewalks, or work on the ones out front now.
- Fencing: Fences for privacy, pets or a cleaner property line.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: San Francisco plus San Mateo, Contra Costa, Alameda, Santa Clara and Marin counties. In Marin County we don't offer maintenance services.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Request your free consultation. Tell us a little about your project and we'll be in touch to schedule an appointment.

Q: Is my project too small?
A: No project is too small or too big for us. If it's related to landscaping, chances are we can help.

Q: Are you licensed?
A: Yes. We're a fully licensed landscaping company located here in the Bay Area.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.
